Initial release of iaqualink-curl.

- Provides shell recipes using curl to sign in, list systems, and fetch iAqualink pool/home/aux/eXO shadow screens.
- Works without running the iaqualink-mcp server; designed for one-off reads, scripting, and debugging.
- Credentials are securely read from the macOS Keychain ("iaqualink" item).
- Supports session management and environment variable overrides for credentials.
- Write/support commands are available but recommended only for advanced users; use with caution.
- Live verification is pending; derived from the Home Assistant open-source client.
